editorial_note.plain_text: The owner record's existing Wikipedia-derived biography and 1931 birth date point to the famous boxing promoter Don King, but neither proves he is the Don King linked to the McQueen yacht Trisha Ann. A direct interview with the promoter says he has never been out to sea. A current yacht broker, by contrast, says the unnamed boat owners have cruised her from Washington state to British Columbia. The contrast raises a meaningful identity conflict, although a person could own a vessel without sailing it. No public source naming Trisha Ann's owner or connecting her to the promoter was found. Keep the boxing biography quarantined for human identity review rather than importing its career into this research dossier.
